تستلهموا (form X)
# تَسْتَلْهِمُوا (tastalhimū) /tas.tal.hi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# تُسْتَلْهَمُوا (tustalhamū) /tus.tal.ha.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
